Next: turning strategy into acquisition, retention and category-defining outcomes at a high-growth company.

    How I think
    about growth.

    AARRR, run by someone who has had to close the books. Pick a stage to see the levers I pull, the numbers I watch and where I have done it.

    AOV−COGS−CAC−Fulfilment−Returns=Contribution margin

    Every stage above ends up on this line. If a tactic does not move it, it is activity, not growth. And brand is the multiplier on all of it: a strong brand pays less to acquire, converts faster and earns the repeat without a discount.

    A diversified industrial group in Indore: steel and wood furniture (Priyabrat Engineering Works), defence-grade terrain models (PRITHVI) and OEM supply for government and B2B buyers (Priyabrat Infocom).

    Group results are a shared family effort. The bullets here are the workstreams I led.

    B2G sales and bid strategy, GeM portal Sep 2025 to Apr 2026, Mhow
    • Led bid strategy, pricing and compliance across 6 entities, contributing to ₹12 Cr+ in government sales in FY 2025-26.
    • Tripled bid participation and lifted win rate from 15% to 25% by rebuilding documentation templates, compliance checklists and a weekly bid review.
    • Built an L1 price benchmarking model from past GeM award data to price bids competitively without giving up margin.
    Operations and supply chain Feb 2025 to Sep 2025, Indore
    • Managed 50+ vendors and 150 to 200 dispatches a month across 20+ product categories.
    • Built a centralised order-tracking dashboard that cut delivery delays by 40%.
    • Halved outstanding receivables from ₹2 Cr to ₹1 Cr and cut payment cycle time by 30% through structured follow-ups and reconciliation.

    Gurugram, on the payroll of Innov Engineering Pvt. Ltd. Sourcing for an industrial group with plants across Nigeria and West Africa.

    • Owned category sourcing for Capex and consumables: 1,700+ purchase requisitions and ₹117 Cr+ of spend across India, China, Turkey, Germany and Africa.
    • Used ZOPA and BATNA negotiation to cut costs 3 to 7% versus last purchase price, saving about ₹19 lakh a year.
    • Converted requisitions to purchase orders within target lead times: 21 days for consumables, 45 for Capex. Ran third-party inspections and international freight.
    • Visited 35+ manufacturing plants in Nigeria to map process flows and set specs; trained 5 graduate engineer trainees on ERP and sourcing.

    A transformer manufacturer. Hands-on time on the production floor, working alongside senior engineers and technicians.

    • Worked across the manufacturing process, from design and testing to quality control and troubleshooting.
    • Built hands-on technical skills in transformer production alongside a team of seasoned engineers and technicians.
    • Saw how large-scale manufacturing really runs, and why precision and quality decide outcomes in the electrical industry.
